title: CorpusEntry
description: Addressed, provenanced append-only corpus entry (ADR-0.0.37-18). Mirrors gzkit.content.models.corpus.CorpusEntry.

section.description: Template-defined section the entry belongs to; MUST resolve to an AgentContract Pillar id.

tier.description: invariant = verbatim at every setpoint; compressible = thinned by the composer.

classification.description: Advisory-scorecard classification (reuses the Bullet classification enum).

witness.description: Optional gate command that mechanically enforces this entry.

retires.description: Id of an earlier entry this row supersedes (GHI #635). The retired row stays on disk with its provenance; it simply stops binding the invariant floor. Retirement USUALLY shrinks the floor, but it is not shrink-only: retiring a tombstone REVIVES the entry that tombstone retired, and when that revived entry is invariant-tier the floor GROWS instead (reviving a compressible entry leaves the floor unchanged). Either direction moves the corpus fingerprint, so a committed rendition still satisfies a shrunk floor but is no longer PROVABLE against it until recomposed and re-attested (GHI #863).

supersedes.description: Id of an earlier entry this row both retires AND replaces (OBPI-0.35.0-01). Unlike retires, a supersedes row is itself a content row in the effective view.
